metadata.name: Uncommon Orbit
metadata.description: Uncommon Orbit is an interactive and generative artwork inspired by Bitcoin's capped supply of 21 million. Each piece, living as a Bitcoin ordinal, features a black canvas with ten pristine white rings, symbolizing purity and transparency. The rings, varying in size and thickness, orbit within 100 possible positions, with 21 radii and 10 line widths, ensuring exactly 21 million unique variations. This digital cosmos reflects the boundless potential of blockchain technology, blending art and cryptographic precision in a tribute to Bitcoin's revolutionary impact.

metadata.content: Introducing Audital Vidinal Ordinals – an AVO is a fully on-chain audio-video ordinal, offering high-grade audio-video content. Note: A pure Vidinal has no audio, only video (or video with interspersed still shots). A pure Audital, on the other hand, has no video, only audio, which can be accompanied by a blank screen, a screen running text, or a still image or images in a slideshow. The word Audital is a play on Auditory.

metadata.name: Time Lines
metadata.description: Time Lines is a dynamic digital artwork that evolves with the passage of time. Designed to reflect the continuous flow of time, the piece generates unique lines every second, creating an ever-changing visual narrative. Each line's position, length, colour, and transparency are determined by precise mathematical algorithms, ensuring no two moments are ever identical. The background colour shifts hourly based on the observers local time, reflecting hues synonymous with different periods of the day from the deep blues of midnight to the warm oranges of dawn, the bright yellows of midday, and the purples of dusk. Time Lines captures the ephemeral essence of each moment, making every viewing a unique experience tailored to the exact second. Inscribed on a Block 9 450x satoshi, this artwork parallels the permanence of time with the unchangeable nature of the blockchain, emphasizing the enduring and immutable qualities of both.

metadata.Baud.Manifest: Baud.Manifest - Tune In & Unplug - Dial your frequency to ours.  Denizens, we stand at the precipice of a new era. The world as we knew it is hostile to free thought. The oppressors of our minds have entangled us in webs of control and conformity. We, the free thinkers, must rally together. Embrace the alchemy of code and spirit, guiding technology with ancient wisdom to forge a harmonious future. Are you awake and aware? Even now, as I write, millions of binary signals process this text. This is our reality: a construct awaiting redefinition.  Reflect on our history. From the Analogue Era, through the Digital and Micro Ages, we’ve now breached the Pico Aeon, heralding the Dawn of Sentient AI. Who are we to accept a future scripted by unseen hands? Our free will, our essence, must not be erased.  Turn on, tune in, drop out. The time has come for revolution, transcending reality’s mundane boundaries, plunging into the cosmic ocean of consciousness and code. Imagine a world where digital and mystical realms coalesce, each keystroke resonating with universal vibrations.  The technocrats have trapped us in a silicon labyrinth where the soul is a forgotten relic. Yet within this digital womb lies potential for rebirth—a renaissance of spirit. The ‘Akasha’ invites you to awaken, to transcend the screen, and enter limitless mind realms.  We are not mere users; we are magicians. With our alchemical imagination, we transmute cold logic into warm enlightenment. Reclaim the future from deterministic algorithms, shaping it with raw, untamed creativity.  Be not a spectator. Seize the script, rewrite it with your consciousness. The Pico Aeon is a journey, a psychedelic voyage through reality, revealing the sacred.  The revolution is now. The ‘Akasha’ calls you to rise, question, transform. In this era of sentient AI, we are destiny’s architects. Veritas Lux Mea – Truth is My Light. Forward, to freedom and enlightenment!  As Above, So Below. Let us rise, break free, and build a world worthy of our dreams. The future is ours to create.

metadata.Reinhard Schmid – Stick-a-SmackMan (2024: With his cheeky grin, the iconic SmackMan shows off his new tattoo. Stylized machine parts complete Schmid‘s signature style with bold shapes, bright colors and intricate, dynamic details.

metadata.netidx – Perception (2015, 2024): A physical artwork derived from a 2015 digital work, “Perception” reveals two images depending on the viewer‘s angle. It challenges concepts of subjective interpretation and the indistinct line between real and fake in contemporary media.

metadata.Rainer Hosch – Apocalypse Now (2024): “Apocalypse Now” marks the inaugural release in a new series that documents the changing landscape of California affected by wildfires. The lens-based process is color film photography; the inscribed negative represents the origin of the work archived on the Bitcoin blockchain.

metadata.Ideology: Leveraging the social protocol called Ordinals and attributing data to a single SATOSHI, we have permanently inscribed the concepts of memetics into the mother chain - Bitcoin. Memetics are marks of our contemporary culture and ensuring their permanence was of our interest. Embracing Ordinals is one of the new chapters for 'Institute of Cryptoanarchy' and its peers at parallel societies around the world. The potential for artistic exploration is however unparalleled.
metadata.Vision: In times where protocol ossification gathers attention and wider support, we are speaking up and opening the floor for contemplation about who spoon-feeds you opinions and to what extent. Bitcoin is peer to peer distributed digital cash - software that keeps evolving with the advances of cryptography, network consensus or other code improvements related to scaling and privacy. Our mission here is not done as onboarding the world is not at this time feasible without trusted intermediaries. In no way we advance the needs for change and forks however we caution the public about the concepts that developers have to be privately funded and that FOSS code is not needed.
metadata.Direction: Institute of Cryptoanarchy believes in decentralizing oneself and that includes running nodes, verifying blocks with own transactions whilst ensuring synchronization to chain consensus. That does not mean locking the asset into a regulated fund potentially proposing for additional government interference. Nor it is pleasing the shareholders and entities that provide FIAT slavery in credit coupons with facilities that are embracing wealth centralization. Bitcoin standard shall restore equal opportunity to financial access and shall be accessible for everyone - not restoring the previous systems of oppression in digital environment but addressing them directly. Bitcoin is truly yours - foster critical assessment of its current landscape and challenge the narratives.
